# Great Lakes Curling

> > A comprehensive resource covering global maritime trade chokepoints, geopolitical tensions, and entertainment streaming guides.

This site appears to aggregate content from multiple sources including World Economic Forum analyses of critical waterways like the Strait of Hormuz, Suez Canal, and Malacca Strait, alongside TV Guide entertainment listings and streaming recommendations. The content spans geopolitical risk analysis, supply chain security, and modern entertainment consumption.

## Critical Maritime Trade Routes

- [These are the world's most vital waterways for global trade](https://weforum.org/stories/2024/02/worlds-busiest-ocean-shipping-routes-trade): Overview of key maritime chokepoints including Hormuz, Suez, and Malacca
- [The Straight of Hormuz, between Iran and Oman, is the most important oil source in the world](https://weforum.org/stories/2019/07/the-strait-of-hormuz-what-you-need-to-know): Explains Strait of Hormuz role in global oil transport amid Iran-UK tensions
- [Why is the Strait of Hormuz so important?](https://weforum.org/stories/2019/07/why-is-the-strait-of-hormuz-so-important): Analysis of Strait of Hormuz as critical geo-economic flashpoint for trade
- [The world's most important trade route?](https://weforum.org/stories/2014/05/world-most-important-trade-route): Strait of Malacca as world's second-busiest waterway for Asian trade
- [Mapping shipping lanes: Maritime traffic around the world](https://weforum.org/stories/2022/06/shipping-lanes-maritime-traffic-global-maps): Visual Capitalist maps global shipping routes and major maritime lanes

## Geopolitical Risk & Supply Chain Security

- [Four global risk trends likely to shape the planet through 2030](https://weforum.org/stories/2026/02/four-risk-trends-shaping-the-planet): NYU research identifies key global risks: polycentric order, democracy, tech
- [Middle East conflict hits shipping, oil prices, and other international trade news](https://weforum.org/stories/2026/03/us-trade-deficit-international-trade-stories-march-2026): March 2026 trade roundup: Hormuz disruption, oil prices, US tariffs
- [Will a regional conflict re-tangle global supply chains?](https://weforum.org/stories/2023/12/will-worsened-conflict-re-tangle-global-supply-chains): Red Sea attacks threaten supply chains post-Ukraine war disruptions
- [The new energy equation: Why LNG is vital to the future of supply chains](https://weforum.org/stories/2025/07/lng-liquefied-natural-gas-supply-chains): LNG's role in energy security amid Strait of Hormuz disruptions
- [How safe are our supply chains from terrorist attack?](https://weforum.org/stories/2015/12/how-safe-are-our-supply-chains-from-terrorist-attack): Supply chain security vulnerabilities at energy chokepoints like Hormuz
